response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.weathprofile AS weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), m AS (SELECT weathprofile, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) OVER () AS mean_of_avgs FROM g) SELECT weathprofile, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, avg_bandusagepct - mean_of_avgs AS diff_from_mean FROM m WHERE mean_of_avgs IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: 'High side of the cutoff' means strictly greater than 152.1 (detecttempk > 152.1); telescopes with NULL detecttempk are excluded.
The telescope count per weather profile counts all qualifying telescopes, including those with NULL bandusagepct; a NULL weathprofile (if any) forms its own group.
